market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham has consistently finished in the mid-table or upper half of the Premier League in recent seasons (14th in 22/23, 9th in 23/24) and possesses strong financial backing and squad depth. Relegation for a club of this stature typically carries a probability in the 10–15% range, well below the 34.5% implied by the market price.
evidence_points: West Ham finished 9th in 2023-24, showing upper-mid-table stability.
The club's wage bill and transfer spending historically place them among the top 10-12 teams in the league.
Only three teams are relegated each season, usually from the weakest third, and West Ham is not in that cohort.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Premier League standings and club finances
Historical relegation odds for mid-table clubs
